name: cascade_delete
description: In DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey, inside the transaction, the explicit child-table delete `Order.destroy({ where: { o_custkey: c_custkey } })` removes all orders before deleting the customer. This matches an application-level cascade delete and causes observable data loss because GET /api/orders/monthly-trend depends on historical rows in `orders`, which will disappear after a customer deletion.
